title: Affability

inlines.v: AFFABIL'ITY, noun [See Affable.] The quality of being affable; readiness to converse; civility and courteousness, in receiving others, and in conversation; condescension in manners. affability of countenance is that mildness of aspect, which invites to free social intercourse.
